projects.title: Ticket Booking System
projects.description: Full-stack ticket booking platform written in C++17 with a REST API and SQLite database.

projects.title: TinyML Keyword Spotting
projects.description: Keyword spotting model trained on the Speech Commands dataset: a tiny CNN over log-mel spectrograms, exported to TensorFlow Lite.
highlights: Classifies one-second 16 kHz audio clips into six classes: yes, no, stop, go, unknown and silence.
Uses the dataset's own validation and testing lists to keep the split stable; non-target words form the unknown class and background-noise clips form silence.
Exports both a Keras model and a TensorFlow Lite model so it can be used on small devices later.
Scripts for training, single-file prediction and live microphone classification on Linux.

projects.title: Parameterized 10-bit ALU
projects.description: Registered, parameterized ALU in Verilog-2001 with full status flags, verified by simulation, formal equivalence and mutation testing, and synthesized with Yosys to compare a behavioral adder with a structural ripple-carry adder.
highlights: 23 operations on a 5-bit opcode with carry/borrow, signed overflow, zero, negative and illegal-opcode flags; one shared adder handles all arithmetic.
Self-checking testbench with an independent reference model that checks every output on every clock cycle; 0 failures across 10 simulation configurations.
Ripple-carry adder verified exhaustively (2,097,152 vectors) and formally proved equivalent to the behavioral adder with Yosys SAT induction.
Injected 11 realistic bugs into the RTL; the testbench detected all 11.
Synthesis showed the ripple-carry adder uses 24% fewer gates but has 75% more logic depth, and cannot use the iCE40's dedicated carry chain.
